items.title: Derrick Gardner interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, May 9, 2013
items.q: So okay Sonny boy, in class today we are going to learn this.

ctx.x: “Cherokee.” And he comes in and he gets up and plays and he just falls right in. And then we played something like — I think we played “Footprints.” And he just switched like a light bulb and started playing this other way and everything he played just fit right into the chord changes, right into the vibe of the tune, and we were all like whoa, where did this side of Irv come from? We didn’t know he even played like this. And the whole time © Hamilton College Jazz Archive -14-
he was playing I had my note pad and I would say oh, oh really, oh wow. So I learned. So okay Sonny boy, in class today we are going to learn this.
